title:
Daily Protein Blueprint:
Survival RDA vs. Optimal Health
subtitle: Why 0.8 g/kg only prevents deficiency — while 1.2–1.6 g/kg protects lean strength
media_caption: Anchor 25–40g Quality Protein at Every Meal Across Any Eating Pattern

left_panel.title: The Under-Protein Trap
items: ✗ 0.8 g/kg Floor: Minimum survival guideline — never built for active aging
✗ Tiny Breakfasts: Pastries or toast start the day short 25g protein
✗ 8 PM Catch-Up: One giant dinner steak cannot match balanced meal pulses

right_panel.title: Optimal Daily Targets
items: ✓ 1.2–1.6 g/kg Daily: Ideal range for satiety, lifting & muscle preservation
✓ 30g Morning Anchor: Steadily cuts cravings & reactive glucose dips
✓ Animal + Plant Mix: Eggs, Greek yogurt, wild fish, tofu & lentils combine easily

section_heading: 3 Effortless Ways to Hit Your Goal

cards.title: Use Target Weight
cards.desc: If carrying extra body fat, multiply g/kg by your healthy goal body weight.

cards.title: Leucine Trigger
cards.desc: Aim for 25–40g per sitting so muscle protein synthesis flips ON cleanly.

cards.title: Pair Fiber & Water
cards.desc: Keep leafy greens, berries & hydration steady alongside higher protein.

bottom_title: Healthy Kidney Check · Daily Consistency Wins
bottom_points: Safe for Healthy Kidneys: Controlled human trials show 1.2–1.6 g/kg protein does not harm healthy renal function (diagnosed CKD uses MD limits).
Consistent 3-Meal Rhythm: Spreading daily grams cleanly beats swinging between low weekdays and heavy weekend meals.
